messages:
sarah_marketing: Quick ask — need an asset pack for the benchmark launch and webinar promo. Goals: animated microtiles for socials, a compact webinar hero (2 slides), and a tiny inbound lead-routing mockup showing demo vs webinar flows. Deliverables: GIF + Lottie for the animation, SVGs + 2x PNG exports, and one Figma file with editable text components. Need L10n and accessibility checks. Target deadline: EOD Thu.
liam_design: Quick clarifying q: do we animate a cost vs latency curve or keep it as microtile transitions?
sarah_marketing: Prefer a simple animated sparkline showing throughput (tokens/sec) and an overlaid cost per 1k tokens. Core metrics to call out: median latency 120ms, cost $1.80 per 1k tokens. Also include a short badge: "predictable inference".
devin_growth: For socials we need vertical (1080x1920), landscape web hero (1200x628), and square (1080x1080). Brand palette + highlight color #00A3FF. CTAs: ["Try Redwood", "See benchmarks", "Join webinar"]. Also need UTM template for links.
liam_design: Got it. I'll create a 3-tile sprite (static + animated loop). Plan: 3s loop @24fps, smooth sparkline easing, dark & light colorways. Will produce Lottie + GIF (fallback) + exported SVG frames. Any constraints on motion? keep it subtle and loopable.
sarah_marketing: Keep motion subtle. No strobing. Also can we surface one stat overlay: "<120ms median latency" for the GIF first frame, then show cost overlay on loop.
anna_pm: Also need a tiny flow diagram tile (300x600) showing inbound lead routing: webinar registrants -> nurture -> webinar -> demo invitation; demo leads -> Sales_AE -> Solutions_eng. This should be in the same file as a modular tile.
liam_design: Question on routing labels: should the first-touch go to Sales_AE or Solutions? and do we need to show SLA/TAT on the tiles?
devin_growth: @liam_design Sales_AE initial contact, escalate to Solutions for enterprise. Add annotation: "follow-up within 48h" for demo leads. Also provide UTM: utm_source=bench_launch&utm_campaign=bench_apr24&utm_content={variant}.
compliance_bot: Automated check: copy claim "lowest latency" flagged for comparative language. Suggest revision to "industry-leading latency for open models" or include link to benchmark methodology.
sarah_marketing: Good catch. Use "industry-leading latency for open models" and link to the benchmark doc in the caption. We'll add a short methodology footnote on the webinar slide.
liam_design: Uploading initial frames to Figma -> https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/bench-launch-anim (placeholder). I'll tag frames: hero_GIF, hero_static, webinar_slide1, webinar_slide2, routing_tile. Export specs added in comments.
upload_bot: File uploaded: bench-launch-anim (frames marked).
devin_growth: Also need copy variants — hero A: "Ship LLM features faster — with predictable cost." hero B: "Predictable LLM inference: lower cost, lower latency." Make sure components allow easy text swaps for FR/DE/JP. Account for ±30% string expansion.
liam_design: Plan: text as auto-resize components, spacing buffers for localization, and accessible color contrast checks. Exports: SVG (clean), PNG @2x, and Lottie JSON. Will hand off tokens for variants and provide a simple README with naming convention. ETA Thu 5pm PT.
sarah_marketing: :thumbsup: Awesome. If anything blocks certification or legal, tag me immediately. We'll run a quick review once you ping.
liam_design: Will do. Pinging when first export ready.
sarah_marketing: Thanks team — appreciate the quick turn.
